## ⚠️ Built entirely by AI coding agents

**Shale is built entirely by AI coding agents.** Its code, tests and documentation are written by
AI agents (agentic coding), not by hand. The owner decides what Shale should do, sets and
approves the specs, reviews the changes and tests the app. If you do not want to use or support
software made this way, please skip this release; that is a fair choice. More in the
[README](https://github.com/rabalyn/shale#readme).
